title: Plant Human Resources Manager
description:
We are looking for a HR Plant Manager to join our team in our plant in Brazil (Sete Lagoas/MG) . The chosen candidate will be responsible to execute HR strategy, deal with recruitment, training, and development processes, managing local trends and needs building the best team in line with budget, guidelines and local labor laws and regulations. The role creates a diverse and inclusive ecosystem by leveraging talent management, succession planning and accurate total rewards for the assigned Plant, acting in full alignment with the leader above as well as the coherent with the organization model and HR policy and guidelines. HR Manager ensures accurate execution of cost analysis in line with guidance and leads HR administration and payroll processes being a unique point of contact for labor industrial relations and disputes at the plant level.

Activities

  • Defines, develops, and implements HR programs and plans on annual basis for the assigned sites in alignment HR Strategy defined by CHRO and in alignment with the HR Corporate directives, industrial plan, and budget.
  • Manages staff and recruiting processes, implements compensation and reward strategy, and ensures consistency with the organizational model, in full collaboration with the Regional HR, HR Center of Expertise and CHRO.
  • Analyses the country-specific trends on a regular basis, sharing with regional/corporate actionable inputs and insights and contributing to the definition of sustainable and competitive actions and strategic targets.
  • Ensures the execution of corporate global and local guidelines and procedures, implements promptly and effectively corrective and preventive actions to ensure full alignment and compliance with local law.
  • Executes performance management, training, and development program defined by HR Center of Expertise and provides them prompt and accurate feedback to ensure the effective and sustainable roll-out for the sites assigned.
  • Recruits, develops and retains resources, cultivates high potential talents, enables succession plans.
  • Plans how to cover replaces/covers vacant local positions, implements job enlargement, rotation, and enrichment in line with legal requirements, procedures, budget, business and organization model, and Company guidelines.
  • Creates an inclusive environment and adopts and open-door, encourages employees to speak up as key of success.
  • Provides guidance on HR processes, solves issues in line with legal, HR& Organization and business strategy.
  • Ensures the employee relationship management respects the relevant legal and Labour contract requirements, development, compensation, and benefit guidelines practices, in adherence with the company governances.
  • Provides the plant with HR services, including administration, payroll, and industrial relations, collaborating with the HR team and implementing tools and fair labor practices per labor law.
  • Elaborates and monitors the budget, supervising the related processes at the local level aimed at ensuring cost-effectiveness and company sustainable business growth.
  • Oversees and keeps HR costs effectiveness under control promptly identifying opportunities to exploit, managing risk appropriately, and setting up a contingency plan to foster HR strategy deployment.
  • Manages, coaches, and develops assigned staff, ensuring effective talent management and career path
  • Interacts regularly and effectively communicates and networks with key internal and external stakeholders, to deliver assigned targets as well as to ensure an effective alignment of company objectives and strategic goals.

Mandatory Qualifications

  • 5 years proven experience gained in Human Resources management and +2 years as HR Plant Manager, within international companies
  • Proficiency in English (speaking and writing in English is 40% of daily routine)
  • Graduate in Human Resources, Business Administration, Law or Psychology
  • Knowledge of Talent Management and succession planning techniques
  • Knowledge of Compensation and Total Reward techniques, methodologies, tools
  • Knowledge of HR Management, employment-related laws, trade unions organising and management
  • Knowledge of human resources information systems (HRIS)
  • Change Management
  • Knowledge of Product and Production: process, features techniques
  • Data Analysis and performances metrics: methodologies, techniques, tools and applications
  • Budget management and cost control knowledge
  • Live in Sete Lagoas (work in presence is mandatory)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced knowledge in Excel and Power BI
  • Experience with WCM
  • Experience with ISO standards

About Us

We are a dynamic organization with great customers and a culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver amazing results. We are also growing and looking to hire talented and passionate individuals to join our team!

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Operações
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Administração das despesas relacionadas a utilidades, como água, energia e gás, e distribuição equitativa entre os condôminos;

title: Formulation Scientist
description:
Position Summary

The role will provide technical support for local laboratory work, with a primary focus on formulation development to support customer projects, the promotion of Vantage™ products, and customer events. Responsibilities include preparing reports and applying Vantage™ raw materials in formulations, with the goal of providing practical tools for the sales force and supporting strategic customers in the region.

The Research Scientist – Formulation & Application will be a science-driven project leader, responsible for planning, managing, supporting, and executing formulation and product development projects in LATAM, with a special emphasis on Brazil. This role will work closely with global R&D and Marketing teams, ideating, identifying, and developing new products for market launch, contributing to the growth of Vantage Personal Care in LATAM and globally.

Key responsibilities include developing formulations for major customers and evaluating their performance to demonstrate the benefits of our technologies, developing new personal care applications, and creating market-relevant concepts that promote Vantage™ technologies through marketing campaigns, customer events, trade shows, and industry activities. In addition, this role will design and perform (or coordinate) the necessary

performance tests to demonstrate and reinforce the value proposition of Vantage™ technologies.

Position Scope

The position will be located in Brasil.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

· Development of new formulations to highlight ingredients from Vantage portfolio and their added values in formulation (skin care, hair care, makeup, and toiletries applications) according to internal and external needs, such as Marketing campaigns, trade shows, customers events and needs etc.

· Support in tests for performance studies and sensorial tests for costumer projects.

· Contribute to new product development projects to improve VPC product portfolio, including discovering new products based on market trends and customers feedback, assessing technical feasibility, developing the new product, designing and conducting needed performance tests to improve the product design, and finalizing product specs, etc.

· Monitor stability testing of formulations: organoleptic and physicochemical analyses.

· Qualification of Vantage ingredients and issue the report with the results.

· Ensure the efficient operation of the laboratory (respect for SOPs, raw materials and packaging inventory management…).

· Use knowledge of routine laboratory safety procedures, SDS’s and interpretations of hazards/toxicity data to perform all laboratory work in accordance with the written safety manual and site safety policies.

· Be a steward for safety and continually drive awareness to ensure a safe work environment for all employees.

· Understand formulation procedures and technologies and incorporate this understanding into applications that add value to customer products.

· Maintain accurate records of all laboratory work and research in accordance with generally accepted laboratory principles.

· Manage the calibration and maintenance of laboratory equipment.

Note: The duties listed above are not all inclusive and may be subject to periodic updating or revision.

Education & Experience:

Education: Bachelor of Chemistry, Pharmacobiology, Cosmetics Technology, Pharmacy or related areas, linked to sciences (Chemistry).

Experience: between 5 to 8 years’ working experience in the cosmetics and chemical industry.

Knowledge, Skills, & Talents

· Spanish and English speaker.

· Knowledge of development Personal Care products (Formulation & process).

· Being responsible, organized, proactive, problem-solving, easy to work in a team are characteristics inherent to the vacancy profile

· Ability to apply logical and scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.

· Ability to influence and work in cross functional teams.

· Excellent communication skills (oral and written) and interpersonal skills.

· Natural collaborator, contributing to a positive team dynamic.

· Continuous improvement mindset, always seeking opportunities to optimize processes.

title: Bolsista Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Grupo Boticario - Bioguardian
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

No Grupo Boticário, a busca por inovação sustentável e ciência aplicada à beleza se traduz em iniciativas que integram tecnologia, pesquisa e propósito. Nesse contexto, o projeto prevê o desenvolvimento e a validação de metodologias baseadas em técnicas avançadas de biologia molecular, com o objetivo de aprimorar a precisão e a confiabilidade das análises microbiológicas relacionadas à qualidade e à segurança de produtos e processos.

O profissional selecionado também poderá atuar em estudos voltados para a compreensão de aspectos biológicos relevantes ao cuidado da pele, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de soluções mais eficazes e alinhadas às necessidades dos consumidores. Trata-se de uma oportunidade estratégica, inserida em um ambiente que valoriza inovação, rigor científico e excelência em beleza e bem-estar.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo Doutorado em Química, Farmácia, Biologia, Biotecnologia, Bioquímica e áreas correlatas

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Idioma: Inglês intermediário

Projeto: Bioguardian

Principais Atividades:

  • Apoiar nas rotinas de microbiologia: preparo de meios, cultivo e manutenção de microrganismos.
  • Realizar cultivo celular (linhagens 2D e 3D), incluindo preparo de meios, passagens e criopreservação.
  • Participar da implementação e manutenção de modelos 3D e sistemas organ-on-a-chip.
  • Executar técnicas básicas de biologia molecular (extração de DNA/RNA, PCR, ELISA).
  • Apoiar em procedimentos histológicos (fixação, corte, coloração e análise de lâminas).
  • Organizar e registrar dados experimentais, contribuindo na elaboração de relatórios técnicos.
  • Participar da discussão e apresentação de resultados em reuniões de grupo.
  • Auxiliar na redação de artigos científicos e preparação de pôsteres e apresentações.
  • Colaborar na organização e manutenção do laboratório e de materiais de uso comum.

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos

  • Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas, analisar dados e interpretar resultados para apoiar a tomada de decisões;
  • Boa habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Aptidão para atuação colaborativa em equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Proatividade na identificação e resolução de problemas;
  • Flexibilidade para lidar com mudanças nas diretrizes, regulamentações e necessidades do projeto;
  • Mentalidade orientada para resultados, com foco em cumprimento de prazos e avanços consistentes;

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Técnicas de Biologia Molecular, preferencialmente RT-qPCR e PCR Digital
  • Conhecimentos em análises microbiológicas;
  • Experiência com cultivo celular.

Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Híbrido (3 a 5x por semana presencial)

Soft Skills : Trabalho em Equipe, Auto Gestão, Pensamento crítico, Criatividade e Ética e responsabilidade, Criatividade.

title: Complex Investigations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for an Intelligence Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on complex investigations (AML, sanctions, and organised fraud).

You'll act as the core investigative expert for the Brazilian market, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and conduct deep-dive analyses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Conducting in-depth, intelligence-led investigations into high-risk money laundering, sanctions, fraud, and organised crime cases involving customers in Brazil
  • Identifying emerging ML/TF typologies across PIX, credit, retail, and business products, translating findings into actionable insights and control enhancements
  • Ensuring timely and accurate reporting to COAF and supporting MLROs with defensible SAR narratives and documentation aligned with BCB requirements
  • Escalating systemic gaps identified through investigations, raising risk incidents, and coordinating remediation with FinCrime Product and Data teams
  • Contributing to FinCrime governance forums (CRC, ERC, ExCo), providing data-backed updates on investigations, risk trends, and control effectiveness
  • Acting as an interface between CIU, global FIU, compliance assurance, and external regulators during inspections or information requests

What you'll need

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex AML and fraud investigations within a financial institution or fintech, including exposure to layering, scams, synthetic identities, and organised crime
  • A solid understanding of BCB and COAF frameworks, including SAR requirements, sanctions, and fraud-reporting obligations
  • Experience identifying systemic gaps, raising risk incidents, and designing remediation plans across AML and fraud controls
  • Expertise in reading and interpreting transaction data (PIX, credit, card, business), using Looker, SQL, or equivalent tools to detect typologies and outliers
  • The ability to prepare clear, defensible reports and narratives for regulatory filings and internal governance forums
  • To be able to explain complex AML/fraud findings to non-technical audiences, senior management, and regulators

Nice to have

  • The ability to perform deep data exploration using SQL, Python, or visualisation tools (Looker, Power BI) to detect typologies or anomalies
  • Confidence presenting findings, risk summaries, and recommendations to senior management, committees, or regulators
  • An interest in coaching junior investigators and supporting FinCrime capability growth in Brazil
  • Prior exposure to regulatory inspections or audits, including BCB or internal audit follow-ups, with experience presenting control evidence

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Why Top Editors Choose Us:

title: Chief Technology Officer - CTO
description:
Purpose of the Position

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role emerges at a pivotal moment in the company’s evolution. Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading SaaS platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.

More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Modernize without disruption: Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle + .NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.
  • Act as the Integrator of the EOS model: Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.
  • Professionalize the technology organization: Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.
  • Build cohesion and leadership depth: Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.
  • Sustain high performance and growth: Enable technology to support a business plan to double revenues in the next three years while maintaining profitability and quality.
  • Influence and earn autonomy: Gain trust from leadership through credibility, technical acumen, and transparent communication.
  • Drive engagement and culture: Foster collaboration, motivation, and a sense of ownership within the technology organization.
  • Orchestrate transformation across stakeholders: Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.
  • Prepare for scale and possible M&A: Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.

Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Technology leadership: Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in SaaS, fintech, payments, or financial software environments.
  • Transformation delivery: Proven record of leading modernization programs (e.g., replatforming, architecture redesign, or scalability initiatives).
  • Systems architecture expertise : Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies (.NET Framework, .NET 6/7, C#, SQL/Oracle) and infrastructure (on-premises and private cloud).
  • Operational excellence: Background in high-uptime or mission-critical environments (e.g., telecom, data centers, financial systems).
  • Process & governance: Experience implementing OKR/EOS or similar frameworks, ensuring cross-functional rhythm and accountability.
  • Stakeholder management: Skilled at engaging Boards, investors, and C-levels, translating technical execution into business outcomes.
  • Team scaling & culture: Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent in growing organizations.
  • Language: Advanced English, for interaction with an international Board environment.
  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; MBA or executive education is a plus.

Behavioral Skills

  • Ownership & Accountability – Takes full responsibility for outcomes and results; drives initiatives to completion without requiring constant direction.
  • Transparent & Courageous Communication – Communicates openly and constructively; brings clarity, confidence, and respect to difficult discussions.
  • Learning Agility & Adaptability – Displays curiosity and humility to learn from others; adapts proven methodologies and continuously seeks better delivery methods.
  • Executive Presence with Simplicity – Translates complex technical concepts into clear business language, operating with accessibility and pragmatism.
  • Collaborative Influence – Builds trust and alignment across peers and teams through cooperation and credibility; leads by example.

title: Fund Manager
description:
Fund Operations Manager (AMIF)

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil - On site

Company: Amicorp Fund Services

Are you an experienced fund professional ready to take the lead in managing complex fund structures, driving operational excellence, and fostering lasting client relationships? Join Amicorp Fund Services , a trusted global provider of fund administration and corporate services, and play a pivotal role in expanding our fund operations footprint.

About the Role

As Fund Operations Manager , you will ensure Amicorp meets all contractual, regulatory, and statutory obligations while actively supporting commercial growth. You’ll oversee the setup and administration of multiple investment funds, manage a dedicated team, and act as a key liaison between clients, investors, and internal departments.

This role blends technical fund expertise , leadership , and a commercial mindset — ideal for someone passionate about both operations and strategic growth.

Key Responsibilities

Client & Deal Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of fund administration clients, fostering long-term, trust-based relationships.
  • Advise on optimal fund structures, legal and regulatory frameworks, and ongoing process improvements.
  • Oversee the drafting and review of commercial, fiscal, and legal documentation.
  • Support fund launches, restructures, and liquidations, ensuring seamless execution and compliance.
  • Attend client and internal meetings to provide technical and operational insights.

Sales & Business Growth

  • Contribute to the commercial growth of Amicorp Fund Services by identifying opportunities and closing deals aligned with business targets.
  • Develop and execute an ambitious sales plan, focusing on expanding relationships with existing clients and attracting new investors.
  • Oversee smooth onboarding and transition management for new clients, ensuring a best-in-class experience.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Collaborate with global accounting teams (India/Mauritius) to deliver accurate and timely fund administration services.
  • Review NAV packages, financial statements, and investor reports to ensure accuracy.
  • Monitor KYC/AML checks, fund compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Maintain comprehensive client records and ensure adherence to all reporting and regulatory requirements.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor the Fund Operations team, ensuring high performance, accountability, and professional growth.
  • Oversee training, performance management, and productivity tracking.
  • Promote standardized procedures, process optimization, and continuous improvement across operations.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree (minimum) with 15+ years of experience in the investment fund industry.
  • Strong professional network within family offices, investment advisers, foreign investors, and the venture capital community.
  • Proven experience managing teams and fund operations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Expertise in fund accounting, NAV calculations, capital calls, audit processes, and tax fund structures.
  • Strong understanding of IFRS / US GAAP and both UCITS and Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) .
  • Excellent client-facing, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Commercially driven, proactive, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Experience with PFX Paxus is an advantage.
  • CGA / CGE certification required.

Why Join Amicorp?

At Amicorp, we believe in empowering our people to lead with purpose, innovate fearlessly, and deliver excellence. You’ll work with a global network of experts, gain exposure to diverse jurisdictions, and be part of a company that values integrity, collaboration, and professional growth.

Join us to make a lasting impact in a dynamic and truly international fund services environment.

✨ Ready to elevate your career and lead with impact?

Apply now and become part of Amicorp’s global success sto

title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for " SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Supervisor(a) Controle de Operações Agrícolas (COA)
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor de Controle de Operações Agrícolas (COA).

Quais as responsabilidades?

Supervisionar as atividades relacionadas ao abastecimento de matéria prima de todas as unidades do grupo, garantindo a execução eficiente das operações da Torre de Controle CTT e Torre de Manutenção elevando a confiabilidade dos apontamos das classes de manutenção do grupo. Coordenar a equipe de operadores, assegurando que todas as metas de desempenho das áreas sejam alcançadas, realizando o acompanhamento diário das operações e implementando melhorias contínuas nos processos.

Quais os requisitos?

Superior completo em Engenharia Agronômica ou áreas afins;

Experiência em operações CTT e Torre de Manutenção;

Sólida vivência com indicadores de performance das operações e equipamentos;

Desejável conhecimento em sistemas como Simplefarm, Gatec, Solinftec, Logtrac;

Gestão de pessoas.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Corretor de Imóveis Corporativo
description:
Estamos em busca de Consultores Imobiliários Corporativos, com ou sem experiência no mercado.

Resumo do Cargo

Você fará parte de uma equipe selecionada de corretores que atuam nos principais bairros da capital (Vila Olímpia, Itaim Bibi, Faria Lima, Brooklin, Pinheiros, Paulista), com a maior taxa de comissionamento do mercado (até 45%), ajuda de custo e treinamento. Sua atuação será identificar oportunidades de negócios, assessorar clientes na compra, venda e locação de imóveis corporativos (conjuntos, lajes e monousuários) e garantir a satisfação do cliente ao longo de todo o processo.

Como Ter Sucesso no Cargo

Para ter sucesso, o candidato deve ter comprometimento, habilidade de comunicação e negociação, bom atendimento ao cliente, ser dinâmico, organizado e proativo.

Como Este Cargo Se Encaixa na Organização

Como Consultor Imobiliário, você atuará como um ponto de contato chave entre a empresa e os clientes, contribuindo para o crescimento da carteira de imóveis e a consolidação da reputação da empresa no mercado. Sua atuação será vital para o sucesso das operações imobiliárias da organização.

Responsabilidades

  • Identificar e prospectar oportunidades de negócios no setor imobiliário corporativo.
  • Conduzir visitas a imóveis e apresentar propostas aos clientes.
  • Negociar condições de compra, venda e locação de imóveis, garantindo a satisfação de todas as partes envolvidas.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências do mercado imobiliário e a legislação vigente.
  • Elaborar relatórios e manter registros de negociações e atividades de clientes.

Qualificações

  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e em equipe.
  • Comunicação verbal e escrita eficientes.
  • Habilidades de negociação.
  • Organização.
  • Competência para realizar análises de mercado.
  • Proatividade.
  • Entender as necessidades dos clientes e oferecer soluções adequadas.
  • Ser persuasivo.
  • Postura profissional e apresentação pessoal adequada

Local de Trabalho:

Presencial - São Paulo, Vila Olímpia

Se você se considera com disposição para evoluir todos os dias e alcançar patamares de excelência, nós queremos você em nosso time!

description:

Acreditamos que a diversidade é essencial para evoluirmos juntos. Por isso, criamos este Banco de Talentos Afirmativo que é uma i niciativa para ampliar o acesso de pessoas de qualquer nacionalidade, gênero, etnia/raça - pessoas negras, pardas e outros grupos — às nossas oportunidades de carreira . Valorizamos todas as trajetórias e buscamos talentos que compartilhem nosso propósito de cuidar e transformar.

Áreas de interesse: Administração, Marketing, Vendas, Compras, Finanças, Logística, Supply Chain, Fiscal, Produção, Qualidade, Assuntos Regulatórios, Laboratório, Produção, Recursos Humanos e outras.

Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento básico de inglês
  • Familiaridade com o Pacote Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

O cadastro neste banco não está vinculado a uma vaga específica, mas nos permitirá considerar seu perfil em futuras oportunidades alinhadas à sua experiência e aspirações.

Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma companhia que valoriza a equidade, a inclusão e o impacto positivo na sociedade.

A Adium tem o compromisso de construir um ambiente cada vez mais diverso e inclusivo, promovendo equidade em nossas equipes. Valorizamos e consideramos todas as pessoas candidatas qualificadas para nossas oportunidades, independentemente da etnia, raça, idade, religião ou crença, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, acessibilidade social, estado civil entre outras protegidas por lei. A diversidade é essencial para evoluirmos juntos e continuarmos construindo nossa história de inovação e alta performance

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
A Toolsworld Brasil traz para o mercado brasileiro a expertise global em ferramentas de alta qualidade. Com uma presença marcante tanto no cenário nacional quanto internacional, somos reconhecidos pela inovação e pela capacidade de atender às mais diversas necessidades dos nossos clientes.

Sobre a Vaga de Consultor de Vendas Externas

Regime de contratação: CLT

Atividades a serem desenvolvidas:

Realizar contato e visitas a clientes ativos e inativos, além de realizar visitas de prospecção de novos clientes, aumentar a venda de mix de produtos do portifólio em sua base de clientes, entender as necessidades dos clientes, através de venda consultiva para clientes, realizar envio de propostas comerciais e pedidos de vendas, de acordo com as políticas de vendas da empresa, monitorar a inadimplência de sua carteira de clientes, manter a base de dados dos clientes sempre atualizada no sistema, realizar relatórios diversos conforme necessidade da empresa e da diretoria de vendas.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Vivência comprovada em atividades ligadas à área de vendas externas, em segmentos de materiais de construção, equipamentos para indústria, marcenaria, pintura, engenharia ou correlatas.
  • Ter atuado no mercado de ferramentas elétricas ou manuais será considerado um diferencial.
  • Possuir veículo próprio (carro).
  • Carteira de Habilitação (válida) – Categoria B.

Remuneração

Composição entre salário fixo e comissão. Maiores detalhes serão informados na entrevista.

Benefícios

Vale refeição por dia trabalhado, Km rodado, Plano de saúde 100% custeado pela empresa

Temos vagas em aberto para diversos Estados do Brasil.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)

About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.

We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.

Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.

Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .

Interview Process

  1. Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  2. Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  3. Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  4. Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

title: Executive Assistant & Operations Associate (HubSpot/Apollo Preferred)
description:
(Only resumes in English will be considered)

Location: Remote (must be able to work Eastern Time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET)

Compensation: Competitive salary with growth opportunities

Start Date:  ASAP

About the Role

We’re one of the fastest-growing proptech companies in the U.S., backed by top-tier VCs and some of the largest landlords and managers in the country.

We’re hiring a Executive Assistant & Operations Associate to keep our revenue engine organized, precise, and moving fast. This role sits at the intersection of sales operations, CRM management, and overall support helping the team run smoother, prep smarter, and close faster.

You’ll support our Sales Directors with everything from HubSpot updates and inbox cleanup to property research, demo prep, and post-event follow-ups. You’ll be the behind-the-scenes force that keeps deals and relationships flowing.

The ideal candidate is a HubSpot pro, an organization master, and someone who loves systems, structure, and clean dashboards. Canva or basic design skills are a big plus.

What You’ll Do

Sales Operations & CRM

  • Maintain CRM hygiene across all deals and pipelines in HubSpot
  • Create follow-ups and tasks from meeting notes to keep deals moving
  • Prepare weekly pipeline reports and monthly sales performance summaries (conversion rates, expansion vs. new logos, etc.)
  • Support with contract preparation, sending, and organization
  • Create and maintain accurate customer accounts within the Cosign portal.

Demo & Meeting Prep

  • Research prospects and properties for personalized sales conversations
  • Build decks and slides for demos
  • Assist with pre- and post-event follow-ups and outreach

Inbox, Calendar & Scheduling

  • Clean up and manage up to 4 sales inboxes weekly
  • Schedule meetings and maintain a sales calendar for QBRs, Expansion, first applicant, property engagement, etc

Sales Enablement & Marketing

  • Update and maintain sales collateral, FAQs, and shared materials
  • Create light Canva designs for decks or visuals
  • Support LinkedIn content coordination and posting
  • Track property-level engagement and follow-ups

Account & Partner Support

  • Conduct strategic account research for new opportunities
  • Track deal follow-ups and ensure nothing slips through the cracks

Who You Are

  • 2+ years of experience in sales operations, CRM management, or executive support
  • HubSpot and/or Apollo expert — comfortable managing pipelines, reports, and automations
  • Ultra-organized with strong attention to detail
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Skilled in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and Canva
  • Proactive, reliable, and fast — you take ownership and anticipate needs
  • Fast learner with a strong interest in using AI tools to optimize and streamline workflows.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a startup or high-growth environment

Need to Have

  • Experience in fast pace high-demanding sales environment
  • Experience at startups, proptech, real estate, or B2B SaaS
  • Strong background in sales/operational support
  • Familiarity with project management tools

What Success Looks Like

  • The Sales teams run with clarity, speed, and zero chaos
  • HubSpot data is accurate, up to date, and ready for action
  • Every demo, event, and partner follow-up feels personal and buttoned up
  • Reports and insights are delivered proactively each week
  • You’re the go-to operator who makes everything — and everyone — run smoother

title: Desenvolvedor de Sistemas - .NET C# e Oracle
description:

title: COMERCIAL SEGUROS - COOPERATIVAS
description:
Sobre a MAPFRE

Você já pensou em trabalhar em uma das maiores seguradoras do mundo? Além de ter o maior e mais completo portfólio do mercado, trabalhamos para proteger milhões de sonhos, vidas, bens e temos como missão cuidar do que é importante para você e nossos clientes, garantindo segurança, tranquilidade e proteção.

Completamos 90 anos no mercado, operando em mais de 100 países nos 05 continentes e contamos com um time de mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todo o mundo. Presente desde 1992 no Brasil, atuamos com Investimentos, Consórcios, Capitalização, Previdência e Vida Resgatável, Saúde, Seguros e Assistência.

Nosso compromisso com a sociedade

Aqui na MAPFRE contribuímos para uma sociedade mais sustentável, solidária e inclusiva. Temos o compromisso em apoiar diversidade, construindo um ambiente com igualdade e equidade. Valorizamos e apoiamos a presença de mulheres em cargo de gestão, a contratação de pessoa com deficiência e o equilíbrio racial e de gênero em nossas equipes.

Essa é a nossa pegada! Gostou? Confira os detalhes da vaga abaixo:

O que você vai fazer?

  • Manutenção da carteira de clientes;
  • Abrir novas frentes de distribuição de seguros - foco prospecção;
  • Capacitar funcionários de cooperativas sobre os produtos e processos;
  • Acompanhar diariamente as medidas de resultado e produtividade - faturamento, conversão, ticket médio, volume de leads, sinistralidade;
  • Trabalhar campanhas de incentivo junto às cooperativas;
  • Representar a MAPFRE no canal Cooperativas da região;

O que a MAPFRE espera de você:

  • Superior completo ou cursando;
  • Pacote Office;
  • Carro próprio / CNH ativa;
  • Disponibilidade de horário e para viagens (importante pois atenderá toda região NORTE);
  • Necessário ter conhecimento em produtos de seguros e suas diversas linhas de negócios;
  • Experiência Comercial / VENDAS (rotina de visitação externa);
  • Vivência em Cooperativas será importante diferencial;
  • Influência e negociação; Foco no cliente e resultado; Organização e gestão de tempo;
  • Facilidade na leitura/interpretação de Dados;
  • Necessário residir em JI-PARANÁ OU PORTO VELHO/RO;

Local de trabalho: ATENDERÁ TODA A REGIÃO NORTE DO PAÍS;

Nossos benefícios para você

A jornada diária conta com horário flexível, formato de trabalho híbrido, incentivo a saúde e qualidade de vida com Plano de Saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Auxílio Academia, Vale-Refeição, Vale-Alimentação, Incentivo a Previdência Privada, Day-off de aniversário, Vale-Transporte ou Fretado, PLR, condições especiais na contratação de seguros da MAPFRE, auxílio babá ou creche, Universidade Corporativa, descontos para estudos e seguro de Vida.

Nos importamos com o desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores e para isso, trabalhamos programas que promovem mobilidade, desenvolvimento, oportunidades de carreira e crescimento profissional. Mais do que apoiar, celebramos cada conquista! Confira nossas ações para promover desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional e pessoal:

Programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento;

Mobilidade funcional e geográfica;

Avaliação de desempenho 360º;

Benefícios sociais e programas de saúde;

Projetos de voluntariado corporativo;
